item.title: ‘Bird In Hand’ Program Explores Bird Banding Research At Merry Lea
item.description: The community is invited to join the Tippecanoe Audubon Society’s winter program “A Bird in the Hand: Bird Banding Research at Merry Lea” on Tuesday, Feb. 10.

item.title: A Two-Piano ‘Musical Experience’ In Mishawaka Feb. 13
item.description: Join pianists Siwon Kim, Ph.D., of Bethel University, and Hyemin Kim, Ph.D., of Interlochen Arts Academy, for an evening of duo-piano artistry.

item.title: Roads, Infrastructure Could Be Renamed After Fallen First Responders
item.description: On Tuesday, Jan. 20, the Senate Homeland Security and Transportation Committee passed four different Senate concurrent resolutions asking to rename various roads and bridges and road infrastructure after fallen first responders and military personnel.

item.title: Kosciusko County Most Wanted
item.description: The Kosciusko County Sheriff’s Office is requesting assistance in finding people wanted on felony or misdemeanor warrants.

item.title: Indiana Bill Would Allow County Fairs To Sell Alcohol
item.description: Senate Bill 23, co-authored by Sen. Brett Clark, R-Avon, and Sen. Ron Alting, R- Lafayette, would allow alcohol usage at local state fairs with a few exceptions, following in the footsteps of the Indiana State Fair.

item.title: Indiana’s Pharmacist Shortage Partly Blamed On Exam Not Required Elsewhere
item.description: Veronica Vernon, chair of pharmacy practice at Butler University, a licensed pharmacist and a pharmacy law teacher, said there are about 2,000 open pharmacist jobs in Indiana but only about 300 pharmacy graduates a year.

item.title: Winning Vegetables for Gardens and Containers
item.description: Include some winning vegetable varieties in this year’s garden.

item.title: Indiana Bill Fast-Tracks Confined Feeding Operations
item.description: Indiana lawmakers are advancing a bill to change how the state approves permits for large livestock farms.

item.title: Indiana Bill Would Expand National Guard Authority During Emergencies
item.description: ndiana lawmakers are advancing a bill which would allow some Indiana National Guard members to exercise police powers during state active duty.

item.title: City Of Warsaw Offices To Open Late Monday, Jan. 26
item.description: City of Warsaw offices will open at 10 a.m. Monday, Jan. 26, due to the weather.
